description: PLATEAU's C02 building fixture read with only wall surfaces extracted, so no building is in the stream: the writer finds no parent for either wall and writes each as a top-level core:cityObjectMember, reported as citygml.parent_not_found, with its openings still nested in it, such as window W1 in wall WS1's bldg:opening. New-world only: the legacy writer flattens the openings onto each wall.
